plan.name: Reuse checked baselines and explain fixed-view refusals
plan.summary: Complete #701 in one plumbing pull request: retain #691's caller-owned context transport and D-0362's captured model, include, full lock and view authority, while distinguishing a missing legacy view, supplied and repaired in baseline/view.json at the original bounds, from a nonempty fixed amendment view whose original reader refusal must name the project's saved .invariant/view.json, require its repair in a separate change and a new amendment issue, and explain that revising the existing issue cannot capture a view-only fix. Give each MCP checker and staged direct-check session its own concurrency-safe memo of successful complete baseline model-gate and reader checks, keyed by exact module/model, include names and bytes, effective view, complete captured lock and relevant pinned tool/configuration identity including actual TLC jar bytes; keep detached chart or too_large evidence, retry failed, canceled and incomplete work, honor cancellation on hits, discard the memo on session exit, rerun every applicable candidate check and rebuild each comparison, and start independent final checking with fresh caller-owned baseline validation rather than drafting caches or artifacts. Preserve faithful bounds, the 500-state boundary, valid-view behavior, publication validation, answer/recovery retention and resets after another ratification or a different project, and repair comparison_repair_test.go to reach the specific missing/stale comparison refusal with otherwise valid ordinary reader evidence plus comparison_648_accept_test.go to require successful tool and final checks with original sources and bounds despite tampered staged old files and specific missing/invalid legacy-view refusals. Update SPEC.md and docs/statecharts.md to describe fixed-view refusal, legacy repair, session reuse and fresh final validation with existing decision citations; the merger records F1-B and the cache refinement including @gitdek's comment at https://github.com/gitdek/invariant/issues/667#issuecomment-6693769970 because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/. Run targeted Go suites for formalize, the CLI and factory comparison flow/answers/context transport, repeat the new concurrency/lifecycle coverage with the race detector, and run the pinned-TLC comparison command in docs/statecharts.md when available; unavailable Docker/network checks and decision recording are Merger work, and applicable real Python and TLAPS CI suites remain required.

tests.name: TestComparison701SessionReuseAndFreshFinal
tests.says: Repeated and concurrent drafting checks reuse one complete detached baseline check, including too_large evidence, rerun candidate work and rebuild comparisons, and final validation and a later session check the baseline afresh.

tests.name: TestComparison701LegacyAndToolKeys
tests.says: Missing and invalid legacy views keep their actionable supplied-view repair path; changed view bytes, Java image and TLC jar bytes trigger fresh baseline work at the original bounds, and only complete successes are reused.

tests.name: TestComparison701RetriesIncompleteAndCanceledChecks
tests.says: Failed and incomplete baseline attempts remain retryable under the same inputs; cancellation never returns cached success, recovery reuses only checked evidence, and final validation independently reruns the baseline.

tests.name: TestComparison701FixedViewRefusalAndRecapture
tests.says: Malformed and hiding-invalid captured amendment views refuse with their original cause and saved-project repair/new-issue guidance in prompts, drafting feedback and final diagnostics; staged replacements and a view-only branch fix cannot repair a saved amendment, but a new issue captures the corrected view.

tests.name: TestComparison701MCPReusesItsBaseline
tests.says: The MCP check tool reuses its captured baseline only within its own session, reruns candidate checks, keeps its allowance/log behavior, ignores staged old-file replacements, and a new checker starts fresh.

tests.name: TestComparison701MCPExplainsFixedView
tests.says: The MCP tool description and failure text distinguish fixed saved-project view repair from the missing legacy view path and retain the concrete hiding refusal.

tests.name: TestComparison701FactoryRetainsRefusedView
tests.says: Factory refusal posts name the saved view and new amendment remedy, saved markers retain a bad captured view across a view-only branch fix and revision, and a new amendment uses the repaired project.
